title: Introducing: How to Mock Outbound Http Calls for Easier Testing (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Setting up the Handler and simulating responses
Test HTTP request policy and scenarios

features.name: HTTP client Handler
features.description: A new test Handler that intercepts outbound HTTP requests during test execution and allows the programmer to mock responses or issue original requests. It enables testing of integration code without hitting actual external services.
caveats: Redirection status codes cannot be set
All HTTP calls during test execution are routed to the Handler if attached

features.name: HTTP client Handler attribute
features.description: An attribute used to mark a procedure as an HTTP client Handler within test code units. The Handler intercepts HTTP requests and allows simulation of responses.

features.name: Handler functions attribute
features.description: An attribute used to attach an HTTP client Handler to a test method, enabling interception of all HTTP requests made during test execution.

features.name: Request object properties
features.description: The request object has properties including request type, path, query parameters, and has secret URI property that can be analyzed to differentiate between requests and populate appropriate responses.
caveats: When request URI is set using secret text, path and query parameters are not available

features.name: Fall-through mechanism
features.description: Allows programmers to decide in the Handler whether to mock a response or issue the original request. Uses a Boolean return value where exit true issues the original request and exit false uses the mocked response.
caveats: Default return value is false which blocks outbound requests and returns mocked response

features.name: Test HTTP request policy
features.description: A new property that can be added to test codeunits to specify how outbound requests should be treated during test execution. Options include allowing all requests, allowing only Handler-issued requests, or blocking all unhandled requests.

features.name: Allow all outbound requests policy
features.description: Default value for test HTTP request policy. No restrictions are imposed on outbound requests during test execution.

features.name: Allow outbound from Handler policy
features.description: Restricts outbound requests to only those intercepted by an HTTP client Handler and issued to the external endpoint using exit true. Ensures no unintentional requests are made.

features.name: Block outbound requests policy
features.description: All outbound requests must be intercepted and handled by an HTTP client Handler. Useful to prevent automated CI/CD pipelines from hitting actual endpoints.
